pairs.rule_a_desc: Adopting a new domain track (mobile, ML, blockchain, IoT, gaming) — gates import on demand, ownership, CI fit, Sunset compatibility BEFORE harvest
pairs.rule_b_desc: Creating, editing, or reviewing skills — minimum quality standard, every skill must be executable, validated, and self-contained

pairs.rule_a_desc: Editing inside .augment/ or .agent-src.uncondensed/ — files MUST stay project-agnostic AND any add/rename/delete syncs counts and cross-references in the same edit
pairs.rule_b_desc: Creating, editing, or modifying files in .agent-src/ or .augment/ — source of truth is .agent-src.uncondensed/, never edit generated dirs directly

pairs.rule_a_desc: Running CLI commands that produce verbose output — git, tests, linters, docker, build tools, artisan, npm, composer. Wrap with rtk; tail/grep fallback
pairs.rule_b_desc: Running PHP commands inside Docker containers — artisan, composer, phpstan, rector, ecs, phpunit, tests, migrations, and any CLI tool execution

pairs.rule_a_desc: When authoring or executing roadmaps — forbid task ci / make test / npm run check steps when quality.local_auto_run is false; skip inline at execution
pairs.rule_b_desc: Any roadmap touch (file move, checkbox flip, phase change) regens dashboard same response; archive at 0 open. Autonomous runs flip checkboxes inline

pairs.rule_a_desc: Creating a new skill, rule, command, or guideline, or significantly rewriting one — runs mandatory Understand → Research → Draft before drafting
pairs.rule_b_desc: After creating or significantly improving a skill, rule, guideline, or command — ask if it should be contributed upstream to the shared package

pairs.rule_a_desc: Git commit message format, branch naming, conventional commits, committing, pushing, or creating pull requests
pairs.rule_b_desc: Git history operations — never rebase/squash/amend without explicit request; once pushed, rewrites must pair with immediate re-push in same turn
